about: Four levels, measured from the hand-made project 'IMG_6808 - 3 บทสรุป คุณค่าไม่มีถูกไม่มีผิด': normal white text, the largest emphasis (its colour can be changed per line), a small reading subtitle with a dark shadow (language th = the spoken Thai line, the default here; en = translation), and a short second-person line off centre and tilted. The second role is not in that project: its numbers are a starting point to tune.
